curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: represent numbers 1 to 30 using concrete objects

mission.title: represent numbers 1 to 30 using concrete objects

interactions.feedback: Yes! Four mangoes show the number 4.
interactions.retryHint: Touch each mango once as you count: 1, 2, 3, 4.

interactions.prompt: Let us show 8. Put 8 bottle tops on the mat.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a bottle top to move it onto the mat.
interactions.feedback: Great! Eight bottle tops represent the number 8.
interactions.retryHint: Move one bottle top at a time and count up to 8.

interactions.prompt: One bundle has 10 sticks. Which group shows 12 sticks?
interactions.feedback: Well done! One bundle of 10 and 2 single sticks make 12.
interactions.retryHint: Start with the bundle of 10. Count 2 more: 11, 12.

interactions.prompt: Use bundles and single sticks to show 17.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap bundles and single sticks to move them onto the mat.
interactions.feedback: Correct! One bundle of 10 and 7 single sticks show 17.
interactions.retryHint: Use 1 bundle for 10. Then count 7 single sticks.

interactions.prompt: A shopkeeper needs 23 bottle tops for a game. Show 23 using groups of 10 and single bottle tops.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap groups of 10 and single bottle tops to move them onto the mat.
interactions.feedback: You got it! Two groups of 10 and 3 single bottle tops show 23.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Use bundles of sticks to show 30.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each bundle of 10 to move it onto the mat.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Three bundles of 10 represent the number 30.
